The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Section 528 Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS") has been filed by the applicant with the following relief:-
"Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the impugned order dated 21.2.2025, passed by the learned II Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lakhimpur Kheri, in Criminal Case No. 11564 of 2023; State vs. Jagdish Kumar and Ors. arising out of Case Crime No. 40 of 2023,
under Sections 420, 406 IPC, relating to Police Station Sharda Nagar, District Kheri,
as contained in Annexure No. 1 to this petition, in the interest of justice.

Lakhimpur Kheri
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned AGA has raised a preliminary objection regarding the maintainability of the present application as the applicant has a statutory alternative remedy for filing revision under Section 399 Cr.P.C. read with Section 401 Cr.P.C.
After arguing at some length, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant may be permitted to withdraw the present application as dismissed as not pressed with liberty to file a revision.
In view of above,the present Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. (now Section 528 B.N.S.S.) is dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the applicant to avail the remedy as may be permissible under law.
Office is directed to return the certified copy of the relevant documents to the learned counsel for the applicant after retaining photocopy of the same.
